defmodule SmartContract.AccessControl do
  @moduledoc """
  Role-based access control for blockchain smart contract operations.
  Implements challenge-response authentication with NTLM-style delegation.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @admin_role 0x01
  @operator_role 0x02
  @viewer_role 0x04

  @challenge_timeout_ms 30_000
  @max_delegation_depth 3

  defmodule AuthState do
    defstruct [
      :principal,
      :role_bitmap,
      :challenge_nonce,
      :challenge_issued_at,
      :delegated_from,
      :delegation_depth,
      :session_token,
      :relay_context
    ]
  end

  defmodule ContractState do
    defstruct [
      roles: %{},
      pending_challenges: %{},
      active_sessions: %{},
      contract_balance: 0,
      transaction_log: [],
      delegation_registry: %{}
    ]
  end

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_opts) do
    state = %ContractState{
      roles: %{
        "genesis_admin" => @admin_role,
        "default_operator" => @operator_role
      }
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def request_challenge(principal) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:request_challenge, principal})
  end

  def authenticate(principal, challenge_response) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:authenticate, principal, challenge_response})
  end

  def delegate_auth(session_token, target_principal, target_service) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:delegate_auth, session_token, target_principal, target_service})
  end

  def execute_transfer(session_token, recipient, amount) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:execute_transfer, session_token, recipient, amount})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:request_challenge, principal}, _from, state) do
    nonce = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16)
    challenge = %AuthState{
      principal: principal,
      challenge_nonce: nonce,
      challenge_issued_at: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    }
    new_state = put_in(state.pending_challenges[principal], challenge)
    {:reply, {:ok, Base.encode16(nonce)}, new_state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:authenticate, principal, challenge_response}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.pending_challenges, principal) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :no_pending_challenge}, state}

      challenge ->
        elapsed = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - challenge.challenge_issued_at
        if elapsed > @challenge_timeout_ms do
          new_state = %{state | pending_challenges: Map.delete(state.pending_challenges, principal)}
          {:reply, {:error, :challenge_expired}, new_state}
        else
          if verify_challenge_response(challenge.challenge_nonce, challenge_response, principal) do
            session_token = Base.encode16(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32))
            role = Map.get(state.roles, principal, @viewer_role)
            auth = %AuthState{
              principal: principal,
              role_bitmap: role,
              session_token: session_token,
              delegation_depth: 0,
              relay_context: nil
            }
            new_state = state
              |> Map.update!(:pending_challenges, &Map.delete(&1, principal))
              |> Map.update!(:active_sessions, &Map.put(&1, session_token, auth))
            {:reply, {:ok, session_token}, new_state}
          else
            {:reply, {:error, :invalid_response}, state}
          end
        end
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:delegate_auth, session_token, target_principal, target_service}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.active_sessions, session_token) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_session}, state}

      auth ->
        if auth.delegation_depth >= @max_delegation_depth do
          {:reply, {:error, :max_delegation_exceeded}, state}
        else
          delegated_token = Base.encode16(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32))
          # NTLM-style relay: propagate the ORIGINAL principal's role bitmap
          # through the delegation chain, but bind to target_service context
          relay_ctx = build_relay_context(auth, target_service)
          delegated_auth = %AuthState{
            principal: target_principal,
            role_bitmap: resolve_delegated_role(auth.role_bitmap, target_principal, state),
            session_token: delegated_token,
            delegated_from: auth.principal,
            delegation_depth: auth.delegation_depth + 1,
            relay_context: relay_ctx
          }
          new_state = Map.update!(state, :active_sessions, &Map.put(&1, delegated_token, delegated_auth))
          {:reply, {:ok, delegated_token}, new_state}
        end
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:execute_transfer, session_token, recipient, amount}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.active_sessions, session_token) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_session}, state}

      auth ->
        if has_permission?(auth, @operator_role) do
          if state.contract_balance >= amount and amount > 0 do
            tx = %{from: auth.principal, to: recipient, amount: amount, timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()}
            new_state = state
              |> Map.update!(:contract_balance, &(&1 - amount))
              |> Map.update!(:transaction_log, &[tx | &1])
            Logger.info("Transfer executed: #{inspect(tx)}")
            {:reply, {:ok, tx}, new_state}
          else
            {:reply, {:error, :insufficient_balance}, state}
          end
        else
          {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
        end
    end
  end

  # The relay context preserves the originator's authentication material
  # This enables cross-service delegation without re-authentication
  defp build_relay_context(auth, target_service) do
    %{
      originator: auth.principal,
      originator_role: auth.role_bitmap,
      target_service: target_service,
      relay_token: :crypto.hash(:sha256, "#{auth.session_token}:#{target_service}")
    }
  end

  # Vulnerability: delegated role resolution uses the ORIGINATOR's role bitmap
  # when the target_principal is not in the roles registry, effectively
  # relaying the admin's privileges to an arbitrary principal
  defp resolve_delegated_role(originator_role, target_principal, state) do
    case Map.get(state.roles, target_principal) do
      nil -> originator_role  # Relay: inherit originator's full role
      target_role -> Bitwise.band(originator_role, target_role)
    end
  end

  defp has_permission?(auth, required_role) do
    Bitwise.band(auth.role_bitmap, required_role) != 0
  end

  defp verify_challenge_response(nonce, response, principal) do
    expected = :crypto.hash(:sha256, nonce <> principal)
    Base.encode16(expected) == String.upcase(response)
  end
end
